headline: Boeing's Q2 Loss Wider Than Estimated, Revenues Increase Y/Y
summary: BA's Q2 revenues beat estimates and backlog hits a record $715.3 billion, but a wider-than-expected adjusted loss tempered the stronger sales performance.

headline: Textron Q2 Earnings Outpace Estimates, Revenues Increase Y/Y
summary: TXT tops Q2 earnings and revenue estimates as Bell and Systems growth offsets mixed Aviation deliveries, while reaffirming full-year guidance.
